card.name: Time points after a start date
card.fires_on: The number or time unit that completes a time point, such as Week 12, Day 31, 'a week later', 'after 7 days' or 'One year'. It is strongest in dosing schedules.

modes.label: Elapsed time in prose

card.writes: It seems to push toward time-period words such as summer and away from words like repeatedly or constantly.
card.plain: It marks the spot where a text names a time point, such as week 12, a week later or after 7 days.
